description: The Santiago confrontation is described as involving a community, but no attendance count or estimate is given; the 50-person threshold is unverified.
required_followup: Find a contemporaneous account that estimates how many people were physically present at once. Preserve qualitative wording if no numeric estimate exists; do not infer a minimum from “community”.

description: The available account does not state a participant demand or identify a policy target for the Santiago confrontation.
required_followup: Locate a source quoting participants or identifying the issue and intended state addressee before assigning a demand category.

description: Only the month is established for the Santiago confrontation. Its day, physical beginning and ending are not reported.
required_followup: Seek contemporaneous local coverage or the underlying OCC incident entry to verify the occurrence date and episode endpoints separately.

description: The OCC account says merchant arrests preceded the confrontation. It does not describe a state response to the protest episode itself or who ended it.
required_followup: Verify police conduct during and after the confrontation, including any accommodation, arrests, beating, dispersal, shooting, killing, or explicit non-response; do not recode the precipitating arrests as protest response.

description: The Santiago episode appears in the OCC monthly account. Diario de Cuba search-result text repeats OCC’s summary, and two exact body requests failed technically; no independent event-level corroboration was read.
required_followup: Locate a contemporaneous account with an independent reporting origin; distinguish any republication or summary of OCC from corroboration.

description: The official Mass Mobilization baseline, original country-month universe and candidate eligibility record were outside this worker lane and remain unverified; no official approval is made.
required_followup: Coordinator should verify the preserved official baseline, country-month row, codebook and inclusion rules before any materialization.

description: This is a bounded open-web first pass using Spanish and English discovery, weekly windows, selected independent Cuban outlets, and city/service-specific searches. It does not provide systematic access to local archives or complete coverage across Cuba’s provinces and sectors.
required_followup: Continue with dated regional outlet archives and local-language searches across provinces and issue areas; preserve unsuccessful and inaccessible coverage as gaps rather than infer no events.

description: The Diario de Cuba body returned reader Internal Error twice without an HTTP response; the EFE Marcha de las Antorchas URL returned HTTP 429 and no body. These are recorded as retrieval outcomes, not publisher denials or evidence of absence.
required_followup: If follow-up is warranted, obtain a fresh exact-URL receipt and manual current/canonical/origin/alias review before any retry; do not use alternate URLs or syndicated copies to bypass a hold.

description: Search headers surfaced a Marcha de las Antorchas report, a Pedro Albert walk described as solo, and a Damas de Blanco Sunday detention report. Their body details, event dates, demands and/or group size were not verified, so they are not coded as events or exclusions.
required_followup: Verify the event date and body evidence through each exact URL only after a fresh receipt and manual hold review; determine whether each was a qualifying public gathering of at least 50 directed at a Cuban state target.
